title: Pet Never Unfollows
description: Minecraft Fabric mod that ensures pet teleportation across unloaded chunks and dimensions
body:
# Pet Never Unfollows
a Minecraft Fabric mod that improves pet teleportation mechanic so you never loose them while travling fast.\
it is fork of [Better Pet Teleporting](https://github.com/MagicJinn/Better-Pet-Teleporting) by [MagicJinn](https://github.com/MagicJinn) to support Fabric loader and modern minecraft.

## Features
- Pets are able to follow you across dimensions. (portals are disabled for pets.)
- Automatic support for mods (assuming they inherit the `EntityTameable` class).
- Pet teleportation is randomized, meaning loads of pets will usually not cause entity cramming.

## Limitations
- Portals are disabled for pets (in favour of custom teleporting logic).

## no dependency
does not depend on any of API, library mods.

# porting
i will not port this to forge, neoforge, older minecraft versions.
if you really need it, you fork it.
